summary: Barclays Bank PLC filed Form 6-K, a routine report of a foreign private issuer under the 1934 Act, for the period ending June 30, 2026. The filing contains quarterly financial data, including IFRS-based disclosures on credit risk, mortgage and credit card portfolios, and expected credit losses. It does not announce any special-situations transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The document is a standard interim financial statement filing with no change-of-control elements or event-driven corporate action. No deal terms, advisor names, board recommendations, or risk-arb angles are present.
